DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis

The clinical picture of progressive joint pain in the hips and knees that worsens with activity and improves with rest, combined with your age, strongly points to osteoarthritis. The involvement of the first metatarsophalangeal joint (great toe) suggests a specific variant known as Hallux Rigidus.
